title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars - Geno's Rawest Beats! 🍄 ~ Beware of Forest Mushrooms (Hoodie-mix)
description:
❝ Super Mario RPG
It is the only one just for me
When I play the game, I get lost in a phase
Then I find out I'm stuck in Geno's Maze ❞
ㅤ- Chris “Kirbopher” Niosi, Rawest Forest (2007)

Did an arrangement of Beware of the Forest Mushrooms from Super Mario Role-Playing Game (ft. All About It by Hoodie Allen). Ah yes, a Forest Maze remix in 2025, and it's featuring a really old song that I'm a li'l too attached too.

Not often I do more slower mixes like this, but I miss turning more calmer tracks into upbeat.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C# Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. D Minor (Custom Pitch)
ㅤ3. C Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay, but shortens the song (LOW Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. Drastically Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)
